Opening times

We are open from Tuesday to Sunday. Opening hours for our reading rooms, exhibitions, and other facilities vary. Please check our opening times and closure dates before planning your visit.

Getting here

The National Archives is located in Kew, southwest London. Find out how to reach us by car, bike, coach and public transport, including accessible routes.

We are closed every Monday.

We are closed on all English bank holidays.
